meta.title: Life satisfaction
meta.question: How satisfied are Poles with their lives?
meta.measure: Average satisfaction with life as a whole, from 0 (not at all satisfied) to 10 (completely satisfied)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on satisfaction with life as a whole, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: All things considered, how satisfied are you with your life as a whole these days? (1 dissatisfied ... 10 satisfied)
items.notes: EVS 1990, 1999, 2008, 2017 (4 surveys); only the end points are labelled.

items.wording: All things considered, how satisfied are you with your life as a whole these days? (1 dissatisfied ... 10 satisfied)
Are you on the whole satisfied with ... your life as a whole? (very satisfied, rather satisfied, moderately, rather dissatisfied, very dissatisfied)
items.notes: CBOS annual battery (December; Apr 1999), 1999-2017, 19 surveys. Dec 2003 labels code 1 'Bardzo zadowlony' (allowed for).

items.wording: As EB_LIFESAT_4 (coded 1 very ... 4 not at all satisfied)
items.notes: CCEB Jan 2000, Oct 2001, Sep 2002, May 2003, Oct 2003: 5 waves.

items.wording: As EB_LIFESAT_4 (coded 1 not at all ... 4 very satisfied)
items.notes: CCEB 2002.1 (Mar - Apr 2002) only, reversed codes, in a domain-satisfaction battery. 2003.5 (filtered, 2-point) and 2004.1 (5-point with a midpoint) carry the same label and fail the label check, as intended.

items.wording: All things considered, how satisfied are you with your life as a whole nowadays? (0 extremely dissatisfied ... 10 extremely satisfied)
items.notes: ESS rounds 1-11 (2002-2023). Round 10 (self-completion) reads 0.8-1.2 points lower than rounds 9 and 11 (unweighted means 7.0, 6.2, 7.4), a mode effect; MODE_SPLITS must apply.

items.wording: On the whole, are you very satisfied, fairly satisfied, not very satisfied or not at all satisfied with the life you lead?
items.notes: EB, Oct 2004 (ZA4229) - Mar 2026, 68 waves (incl. zipped ZA4565). From Jun 2021 most files also carry a 'daily life' variant (d70a), which the $ anchor excludes.

items.wording: How satisfied are you with your life overall: very satisfied, somewhat satisfied, somewhat dissatisfied, very dissatisfied
All in all, are you satisfied with your whole life? (very satisfied ... very dissatisfied; midpoint 'a bit satisfied, a bit dissatisfied')
items.notes: CBOS Nov 2012 and Jan 2013, 2 surveys; stand-alone question, midpoint worded differently from CBOS_LIFESAT_5.

items.wording: Generally speaking, are you satisfied with your life? (very satisfied, rather satisfied, rather dissatisfied, very dissatisfied)
All things considered, how satisfied are you with your life as a whole nowadays? (0 extremely dissatisfied ... 10 extremely satisfied)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Generally speaking, how satisfied are you with your life? (1 not at all ... 10 completely satisfied)
items.notes: FNW SWPS online survey May 2026 only.
